title.target: Deduction in the past and present
title.en: Deduction in the past and present

ex.t: The police found a clue at the scene.
There is no evidence to suspect him.
She deduced the answer from the facts.
There is a possibility of rain.
I suspect he knows the secret.
ex.ko: 나는 그가 비밀을 알고 있다고 의심해요.

ex.t: That is the most logical explanation.

title.ko: must have · can't have · might have · must be -ing
title.en: must have · can't have · might have · must be -ing

explain.ko: 확신의 정도에 따라 조동사를 고릅니다. 과거에 대해 틀림없다고 볼 때는 must have + 과거분사, 가능성이 약할 때는 might/may/could have + 과거분사, 불가능하다고 볼 때는 can't/couldn't have + 과거분사입니다. 지금 이 순간에 대해서는 must be + -ing(진행 중임이 틀림없다), can't be + -ing, might be + -ing를 씁니다. 판단의 근거(단서, 증거)를 함께 말하면 논리적으로 들립니다. must는 ‘반드시 ~해야 한다’가 아니라 확신을 나타낸다는 점에 주의하세요.
explain.en: Choose the modal according to how sure you are. For the past: must have + p.p. (certain), might/may/could have + p.p. (possible), can't/couldn't have + p.p. (impossible). For the present: must be + -ing, can't be + -ing, might be + -ing. Give your evidence to sound logical. Note that must here shows certainty, not obligation.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: She might have missed the bus.

notes.ko: 과거 확신에 have to는 쓰지 않습니다. He had to forget(×) → He must have forgotten.
notes.en: Don't use have to for deductions: He must have forgotten.

notes.ko: can't have는 ‘~했을 리가 없다’로 강한 부정 추측입니다. mustn't have는 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Use can't have for impossibility; mustn't have is not used.

notes.ko: 추측의 근거를 because, since와 함께 말하면 설득력이 높아집니다.
notes.en: Add a reason with because or since to sound convincing.

examples.t: He can't have been at home. The lights were off.
examples.ko: 그는 틀림없이 집에 없었어요. 불이 꺼져 있었으니까요.

examples.t: She might have left her keys somewhere.
examples.ko: 그녀는 열쇠를 어딘가에 두고 왔을 수도 있어요.

examples.t: They must be having a meeting now.
He can't have left early yesterday.
examples.ko: 그는 어제 일찍 퇴근했을 리가 없어요.

examples.t: The thief could have escaped this way.
examples.ko: 범인이 이 길로 도망쳤을 수도 있어요.

practice.q: He ___ forgotten the meeting; he never misses one.
She ___ been at home. Her car wasn't there.
They ___ having a meeting now. The lights are on.
He ___ got stuck in traffic. I'm not sure.

lines.t: Where do you think my wallet went?

options: You might have left it on the bus.
You might leave it on the bus.
You must leave it on the bus.

lines.t: Why do you think he hasn't arrived yet?

options: He might have got stuck in traffic.
He might be got stuck in traffic.
He must get stuck in traffic.

lines.t: My wallet has disappeared. Where could it be?
You might have left it on the bus.
I can't have. I definitely put it in my bag.
Then someone must have taken it. Let's report it to the police.

trans.ko:
A: 내 지갑이 사라졌어. 어디로 갔을까?
B: 버스에 두고 내렸을지도 몰라.
A: 그럴 리 없어. 분명히 가방에 넣었어.
B: 그럼 누군가 가져갔음이 틀림없어. 경찰에 신고하자.

questions.q: What does the woman think happened to her wallet?
options: She put it in her bag
She dropped it in the street

lines.t: A theft took place at a shop last night. The police say the thief must have come in through the back door, because the front door was locked. There are too few clues, so they don't yet know who it was.

trans.ko: 어젯밤 가게에서 도난 사건이 일어났어요. 경찰은 도둑이 뒷문으로 들어왔음이 틀림없다고 말해요. 앞문은 잠겨 있었기 때문이에요. 단서가 너무 적어서 아직 범인을 알 수 없어요.

questions.q: How did the thief get in?

items.passage:
A MYSTERY STORY
In the morning villagers found that the fountain in the square had disappeared. Nobody is said to have heard any noise during the night. Some claim aliens took it, while others say someone must have moved it by truck.

trans.ko:
수수께끼 이야기
아침에 마을 사람들은 광장의 분수가 사라진 것을 발견했다. 밤새 아무 소리도 들리지 않았다고 한다. 어떤 사람은 외계인이 가져갔다고 주장하고, 다른 사람은 누군가 트럭으로 옮겼음이 틀림없다고 말한다.

questions.q: What did the villagers find in the morning?
options: The fountain was moved to the park

items.passage: Minho was an hour late for the appointment. His friends said he might have got stuck in traffic. But Minho said he had left his car at home, which surprised everyone.

trans.ko: 민호는 약속에 한 시간 늦었어요. 친구들은 그가 교통 체증에 걸렸을지도 모른다고 말했어요. 하지만 민호는 차를 두고 왔다고 해서 모두 놀랐어요.

prompt.ko: 미스터리한 사건에 대해 과거와 현재 추측 표현을 써서 4문장 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a mystery, using modals of deduction for the past and the present.

task.model: My wallet disappeared yesterday. I might have left it on the bus. But I put it in my bag, so I can't have. Someone must have taken it.

model_trans.ko: 내 지갑이 어제 사라졌어요. 나는 버스에 두고 내렸을지도 몰라요. 하지만 가방 안에 넣었으니 그럴 리는 없어요. 누군가 가져갔음이 틀림없어요.
model_trans.en: My wallet disappeared yesterday. I might have left it on the bus. But I put it in my bag, so I can't have. Someone must have taken it.
